title: Local Luc folder admission
summary: Read ordinary .luc files beside this machine's config, import immutable bytes, select the newest version and report refused packages independently.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: local_folder
operations.notes: No deadline is enforced by this synchronous Python seam. Retrying a read observes the current state.

operations.name: reserved_reason
operations.notes: No deadline. Refusal codes are returned in a mapping, not raised. Unknown protocols are reserved as well as the explicitly reserved table.

operations.name: read_local_lucs

folder.description: Path or None; symlink folders are ignored.

switches.description: Mapping of Luc/layer id to bool.

operations.notes: No deadline. Retry rechecks folder/config and imports same identities naturally. Other verifier, review and Registry codes are returned as refused rows; this list is not closed. Newest semantic version wins; sorted filename breaks equal-version ties. Existing disabled state carries forward; an explicit switch wins. The Registry import is a side effect even though this is called a reader.

invariants.text: Local packages cannot use lumeri. identities, Official capability names, unknown/reserved protocols or reserved permissions.
Reviewed authority is granted only by an in-date receipt bound to the bytes held in the Registry.
A local Luc or folder layer targeting another platform is refused with E_LUC_PLATFORM before being imported into the Local Registry.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

local_lucs.description: Frozen LocalLucs dataclass: active tuple of (LucArtifact, provenance dict); states Mapping[id,bool]; off and refused tuples of metadata dicts; layers tuple of (Extension artifact, {file,identity,extends}). Identity is artifact-manifest-v1 /properties/identity. These Python tuples and artifact instances are not JSON wire values.
